description: A real data set for a 116-node power transmission system is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Meltem Peker. This data is used in “A Two-Stage Stochastic Programming Approach for Reliability Constrained Power System Expansion Planning” article by Peker, M., Kocaman, A. S., and Kara, B. Y. (2018). (Peker, M., Kocaman, A. S., & Kara, B. Y. (2018). A two-stage stochastic programming approach for reliability constrained power system expansion planning. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
